entries.en: Breaking change: Bedrock ARN passed to `ANTHROPIC_MODEL` or `ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL` should no longer contain an escaped slash (specify `/` instead of `%2F`)
entries.zh: 重大更改：传递给`ANTHROPIC_MODEL`或`ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL`的基岩 ARN 不应再包含转义斜杠（指定`/`而不是`%2F`）

entries.en: Removed `DEBUG=true` in favor of `ANTHROPIC_LOG=debug`, to log all requests
entries.zh: 移除 `DEBUG=true`，改用 `ANTHROPIC_LOG=debug` 来记录所有请求
